notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Features

[list]
[*] Achievements for reaching more complex waves of enemies
[*] Stats to show which Power-Ups you have used throughout your playthroughs
[*] High Score is saved as a stat as well to show off how good you are at the game :)
[/list]

Tweaks

[list]
[*] The game now runs in x64 instead of x86 due to Steamworks requiring it
[/list]

notes.title: Cell Defender now on MonoGame!
notes.notes: This game has been around for a long time during my time developing and despite some strange feedback from some users I still wanted to provide an update for those who do like the game. The game now runs off of MonoGame which should help some users who could not get the game running without prerequisites. I also just turned on the list of powerups to show at the start. Hope you enjoy!
